business_summary: Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited engages in the production of metallurgical grade alumina and aluminium products. The company provides aluminium ingots, foundry alloys, billets, slabs, wire rods, flip coils, and rolled and other products under the VEDANTAL brand. It also operates an independent power plant with a capacity of 3015 megawatts. The company's products are used in aerospace, aviation, defence, transportation, electricity distribution, packaging, and other sectors. Vedanta Aluminium Metal Limited was incorporated in 2023 and is based in New Delhi, India.
